info.title: rusticdoc
info.description: Fills Office and PDF templates from JSON, converts documents with LibreOffice, and runs PDF operations. One multipart request does the whole job; webhooks deliver results asynchronously.

get.summary:
Liveness. With credentials configured, a caller without them sees the status
and nothing else.

Prometheus text format. With credentials configured it needs them too, unless
`RUSTICDOC_METRICS_PUBLIC` is set.

Readiness: liveness, and with a store, this replica's copy of the stored fonts
being complete. A load balancer should send no documents here before that,
because they would quietly come out in a fallback font.

post.summary:
Converts uploads with LibreOffice and runs any post-processing fields.
Several files come back as a ZIP, or as one PDF with `merge=true`.

200.description: The converted file, or a ZIP of them

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

503.description: An engine is unavailable or the request timed out

get.summary: Lists the fonts LibreOffice and the PDF stage can use.

post.summary:
Stores fonts for every caller and every replica: a ZIP of TTF, OTF or TTC files,
or one such file. Takes an admin key. They are in use on this replica when this
returns, and on the others within `syncIntervalSeconds`.

403.description: Needs an admin key, or the store is full

post.summary:
Rescans the fonts directory and restarts idle LibreOffice workers, so a
new font needs no container restart. Busy workers restart after their
current job.

delete.summary:
Deletes a stored font. Takes an admin key. It leaves this replica when this
returns, and the others within the sync interval. Documents that name it fall
back to another font.

post.summary: Reads the outline of each PDF sent, keyed by file name.
Replaces the outline.

200.description: The PDF with its outline replaced

post.summary:
PDFs to PDF/A or PDF/UA through LibreOffice, with the same
post-processing fields as `/v1/convert`.

200.description: The converted PDF, or a ZIP of them

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

503.description: An engine is unavailable or the request timed out

post.summary: Attaches files to a PDF.
Encrypts a PDF with AES-256.

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

503.description: An engine is unavailable or the request timed out

post.summary: Embeds Factur-X invoice XML and marks the PDF for it.
Flattens forms and annotations into the page content.
Lists a PDF's form fields with their kinds, pages and values.

Fills a PDF form from data, applying tags in annotations, optionally
flattening the result.

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

post.summary: Merges PDFs in the order sent.

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

503.description: An engine is unavailable or the request timed out

post.summary: Reads the metadata of each PDF sent, keyed by file name.
Writes metadata keys; existing keys not named are kept.

200.description: The PDF with its metadata changed

post.summary: Recompresses streams and drops unused objects.
Lays the second PDF over the first, page by page.

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

post.summary: Rotates pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

Signs a PDF. With `signature=certificate`, a cryptographic signature with
the key in `RUSTICDOC_SIGNING_KEY` and `RUSTICDOC_SIGNING_CERT`: an
incremental update with a PAdES B-B style `/ETSI.CAdES.detached`
signature (no timestamp), invisible, or shown with the one image sent.
Without a configured key that answers 503. By default
(`signature=image`) the images are drawn at exact coordinates, which is
not a cryptographic signature.

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

503.description: signature=certificate and no signing key is configured, or the certificate has expired

post.summary:
Splits a PDF by page ranges or into fixed intervals; several outputs
come back as a ZIP.

200.description: A PDF, or a ZIP of PDFs

post.summary: Puts text, an image or a PDF over the content of each page.
Puts text, an image or a PDF under the content of each page.
Fills a template and runs the steps.
post.description:
Add `X-Rusticdoc-Webhook-Url` to get 204 at once and the result by webhook.
With `RUSTICDOC_WEBHOOK_SECRET` set, each caller's deliveries are signed with its
own key: `X-Rusticdoc-Signature` is `v1=` and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of
`<timestamp>.<event>.<request id>.<body>`, with the timestamp in
`X-Rusticdoc-Timestamp`, the event in `X-Rusticdoc-Event` and the request id in
`X-Request-Id`. The key is `HMAC-SHA256(secret, principal)`, or the secret itself
when the service requires no credentials; `rusticdoc webhook-secret` prints it.

parameters.name: X-Rusticdoc-Webhook-Url
parameters.description: Deliver the result here instead of in the response

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

503.description: An engine is unavailable or the request timed out

post.summary:
Renders the template once per element of an array in the data and
returns the files in a ZIP.
post.description:
`splitBy` names the array with a dotted path such as `items` or
`order.lines`. Each render sees the whole data with that array replaced
by the one element, plus `item` (the element) and `batch` (`index`,
`count`). `batchName` is a template for each file's name, default
`{{ batch.index }}`.

parameters.name: X-Rusticdoc-Webhook-Url
parameters.description: Deliver the ZIP here instead of in the response

200.description: A ZIP of the rendered files

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

get.summary: Lists this caller's templates, oldest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, up to 200. Default 50.

post.summary:
Stores a template and returns its id. Syntax is checked now, without data, so a
broken template is refused here rather than at its first render. The content
never changes: to change a template, store the new one and use its id.

404.description: This caller has no such template

BinaryFile.description:
A file in a response, for the API description: generated clients return
it as bytes.

ConvertForm.description:
The multipart form `/v1/convert` and `/v1/pdf/convert` accept.
LibreOffice options (`landscape`, `nativePageRanges`,
`exportFormFields`, `singlePageSheets`, `password`, ...) and
post-processing fields (`merge`, `splitMode`, `watermarkSource`,
`stampSource`, `rotateAngle`, `flatten`, `metadata`, `bookmarks`,
`embeds`, `facturxXml`, `userPassword`, ...) are accepted as well.

merge.description: Merge several inputs into one PDF instead of returning a ZIP.

files.description: The PDF first, then the files to attach.

ErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every error response.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person.

files.description: The PDF/A-3 invoice, then the Factur-X XML.

FieldSchema.description: One form field, as `/v1/pdf/forms/fields` lists them.

data.description:
JSON object, sent as text or as a file; a field named `customer.name` takes
that path.

files.description: The PDF with form fields, and optionally tags in annotations.

flatten.description: Fix the values into the page content.

stripAnnotations.description: Remove the annotations that carried tags. Default true.

id.description:
The stored font this face belongs to, for deleting it. Absent for fonts
in the image or the mounted directory.

mounted.description: True when it came from the mounted fonts directory.

file.description: A ZIP of TTF, OTF or TTC files, or one such file.

skipped.description: Files in the ZIP that were left out, and why.

syncIntervalSeconds.description: In use on this replica now, and on the others within this many seconds.

details.description: Per-module status: `libreoffice`, and `store` when one is configured.

files.description: Two or more PDFs, merged in order.

metadata.description: JSON object of keys such as `Title`, `Author`, `Subject`, `Keywords`.

files.description: Two PDFs: the base, then the overlay laid over it page by page.
The PDF to work on. Several for merge.

changed.description: False when the directory has not changed, so no worker restarted.

RenderForm.description: The multipart form `/v1/render` accepts. Documented here; parsed by hand.

contactInfo.description: For `sign`: how to reach the signer.

ctx.description: JSON object visible as `ctx`, sent as text or as a file.

data.description: JSON object the template sees as its root, sent as text or as a file.

metadata.description: JSON object of metadata fields for `metadata`.

outputFilename.description: File name of the result, without extension.

reason.description: For `sign`: why the document was signed.

signerName.description: For `sign`: the signer's name as shown.

steps.description:
Comma-separated steps in order: `convert`, `pdfa`, `metadata`,
`encrypt`, `merge`, `sign`. `sign` signs cryptographically with the
service's key; it must be last and cannot be combined with `encrypt`.

template.description: The template file. Send this or `templateId`.

templateId.description:
The id of a stored template, from `POST /v1/templates`. Send this or
`template`. Files in the form are then only further inputs, for `merge`.

pages.description: Page selection such as `1-3,5`; all when empty.

contactInfo.description: With `signature=certificate`: how to reach the signer.

files.description:
The PDF first, then one PNG or JPEG per placement. With
`signature=certificate`, at most one image: the visible appearance.

page.description: 1-based page of each image; repeat the field for several.

reason.description: With `signature=certificate`: why the document was signed.

signature.description:
`image` (default) draws the images and is not a cryptographic
signature. `certificate` signs with the service's key (PAdES B-B,
`/ETSI.CAdES.detached`), invisibly unless an image is sent.

signerName.description:
With `signature=certificate`: the signer's name as shown. Validators
identify the signer by the certificate, not by this.

width.description: Width in points. Default the image's natural size.

x.description: Points from the page's left edge to the image's left edge.

y.description: Points from the page's bottom edge to the image's bottom edge.

splitSpan.description: For `pages`: ranges such as `1-3,5`. For `intervals`: pages per file.

splitUnify.description: For `pages`: one file holding every range instead of one per range.

id.description: The hex SHA-256 of the file, so storing it twice changes nothing.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Absent on the last.

name.description: A name for it, in place of the file's. The extension stays the file's.

template.description: The template: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, PDF or a text format.

diagnostics.description:
Every problem found: `severity`, `message`, and a `location` with
`part`, `place` and `snippet` where known.

engine.description: The engine that would handle it: `office`, `text` or `none`.

error.description: The first error, when `ok` is false.

ok.description: True when the template renders with the sample data.

template_hash.description: SHA-256 of the template, the cache key.

engines.description: Paths of the engines in use, or null when absent.
